segments.name: Non-invasive CAD detection solutions
segments.description: AI-powered software platform that analyzes coronary CT scans to diagnose and manage coronary artery disease.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and manages its business as one reportable and operating segment, which is the business of non-invasive CAD detection solutions.

revenueModel.text: Healthcare providers pay per analysis performed on their patient's CCTA scan through direct billing to imaging accounts.
revenueModel.evidence: With a single click, Physicians can access these analyses on-demand, and we bill the account directly for each product selected.
